caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a natural light brown finish, featuring visible wood grain patterns throughout its surface. The cabinet has a rectangular shape with two vertically aligned doors occupying the upper section, each door equipped with a round wooden knob and two metal hinges on the outer edges. Below the doors, there is a single wide drawer with two symmetrical brass handles, each handle attached with decorative backplates. The cabinet stands on four short, slightly curved legs. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a small text on the lower right that reads "EDWARD T. JEWETT."
title: Cupboard
